2837.title: Plugin schema conversion crosses Zod package internals
2837.rootCauseOneLine: The host sends a plugin-owned schema to its own Zod converter, which reads private data from another package instance.
2837.proposedFix: Call the schema-owned JSON Schema converter first and keep the host converter only as a fallback.
2837.caveats: The cross-package boundary failure was reproduced twice. The exact external Zod version pair and marketplace plugin were not run.
